overview.description: The Roundhill Gold WeeklyPay ETF (GLDW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in gold commodities. The fund is an actively managed fund seeking to provide weekly distributions and 1.2x leveraged exposure to the weekly price return of SPDR Gold Trust (NRSE Arca: GLD). GLD tracks the gold spot price, less expenses and liabilities, using gold bars held in London vaults. GLDW was launched on Oct 30, 2025 and is issued by Roundhill.
